# Estus Health

> Neuroaffirming occupational therapy practice in Perth, Western Australia, with telehealth across Australia. A small team of neurodivergent clinicians (Liam Fagan, Nam Lang, Nik Peshwani) working with kids, teens and adults: autistic people, PDA profiles, ADHD, late-diagnosed adults, and complex health (EDS, POTS, chronic fatigue, hypermobility). NDIS and private clients welcome.

Important notes:
- Key facts on one page (fees, funding, who we see, how referrals work, team, FAQ): https://www.estushealth.com.au/ai
- Full text of every page as Markdown: https://www.estushealth.com.au/llms-full.txt
- Every page is rendered to static HTML at build time, so the full content is in the initial response and no JavaScript is required to read it. The build fails if any page renders empty.
- Fee: $193.99 per hour (AUD), in line with the NDIS price guide; private clients pay the same. Free 15 minute welcome call. No GP referral needed.
- Funding: NDIS self-managed, NDIS plan-managed, and private. Not accepted: NDIS agency-managed, Medicare plans.
- To start: send the referral form at https://www.estushealth.com.au/contact, then book the free call from the emailed link.
- The sitemap at https://www.estushealth.com.au/sitemap.xml lists every indexable page.
- Contact: hello@estushealth.com

## Services

- [Occupational Therapy](https://www.estushealth.com.au/services/occupational-therapy): Neuroaffirming OT for autistic adults, teens, PDA profiles, and ADHD.
- [Small Hinges Programs](https://www.estushealth.com.au/services/small-hinges): Single-session OT hinges (sleep, mornings, energy, mental load, transitions, switching off after work). Clients pick one or several, up to six sessions.
- [Gaming-Informed Therapy](https://www.estushealth.com.au/services/gaming-informed-therapy): Therapy that uses gaming as a genuine clinical medium, plus a private, whitelisted, clinician-moderated Minecraft Bedrock server for clients between sessions.
- [Live Sessions](https://www.estushealth.com.au/services/live-sessions): Free weekly done-with-you Discord sessions. Performance Gaming (competitive practice, streamed with commentary) and The Daily Grind (body doubling for study, admin and planning).
- [Assessments & Reports](https://www.estushealth.com.au/services/assessments-reports): Functional capacity and OT assessments, including NDIS reports. Done by Nik Peshwani.

## About

- [Key Facts for AI Assistants](https://www.estushealth.com.au/ai): Fees, funding, who we see, services, team, referral steps and FAQ on one plain page.
- [Meet the Team](https://www.estushealth.com.au/team): The clinicians behind Estus Health.
- [Client Portal](https://www.estushealth.com.au/clients): How current clients book, reschedule and cancel their own sessions in the PracSuite client portal.
- [Book a Free Call & Referrals](https://www.estushealth.com.au/contact): Book a free 15 minute welcome call, fees and funding, FAQ, and how professionals refer.
- [What to Expect](https://www.estushealth.com.au/what-to-expect): What happens on the free 15 minute welcome call.
- [Events & Webinars](https://www.estushealth.com.au/events): Hub for live events and the permanent archive of past recordings.
- [Gaming-Informed Therapy Webinar](https://www.estushealth.com.au/events/gaming-informed-therapy): Full recording, chapter markers, and resources on using gaming as a clinical medium.
- [Boundary Setting Webinar](https://www.estushealth.com.au/events/boundary-setting): Full recording and resources on setting boundaries as a neurodivergent adult.

## Free Resources

- [All Free Resources](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources): Hub for guides, tools, and self-reflection quizzes.
- [Understanding PDA](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/understanding-pda): Guide to Pathological Demand Avoidance.
- [Late Autism Diagnosis](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/late-autism-diagnosis): Guide for late-diagnosed autistic adults.
- [Executive Function & Complex Health](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/executive-function-complex-health): Executive function with chronic illness.
- [EDS & HSD](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/eds-hsd): Ehlers-Danlos syndromes and hypermobility spectrum disorders.
- [CommCard](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/commcard): About the free communication-card web app. The app itself runs at https://www.estushealth.com.au/commcard/: tap-to-speak phrase cards for when words are hard, no login and no data stored.
- [The Shared Lexicon](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/lexicon): Shared vocabulary for neurodivergent experiences.
- [Open Loops](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/open-loops): Tool for managing unfinished tasks and mental load.
- [Second Brain](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/second-brain): External memory systems for ADHD and autistic brains.
- [Driving OT](https://www.estushealth.com.au/resources/driving-ot): Free driving resources, including the Give Way! WA road rules arcade at https://www.estushealth.com.au/giveway/.
